regions.today: Mostly dry today with a mix of cloud and hazy sunny spells and with the chance of the odd light shower. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees with light northwest to west breezes.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight but becoming largely cloudy with limited clear spells. A few spots of drizzle are possible. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees in light southwesterly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy tomorrow with occasional rain and drizzle possible and just limited bright or sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in light, occasionally moderate southwesterly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate Saturday and moderate to high Sunday.
